Ariyil Shukkoor Murder Case: 13 Convicted, Key CPI(M) Leaders Acquitted

A court has convicted 13 individuals in connection with the murder of Ariyil Shukkoor. Seven of the convicts, including the prime accused Sumesh, have been sentenced to life imprisonment. Two prominent CPI(M) leaders, Jayarajan and Rajesh, were acquitted in the case. The Pioneer reported that 11 CPI(M) workers received life sentences in relation to the murder of an RSS leader, though the other outlets identify the victim as Ariyil Shukkoor.
